meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configures a language server so editor/agent tooling (diagnostics, go-to-definition, references, rename) works. Use when a project needs an LSP installed or wired, or a 'no LSP server configured' error appears.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置语言服务器，让编辑器自动提供代码检查与跳转功能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码时遇到未配置语言服务器的提示，导致编辑器没有代码检查与跳转。
copy.tagline_en: Configure a language server to enable code diagnostics and navigation in your editor.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your editor keeps saying no language server is configured when you code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先按文件扩展名判断项目语言，再读取对应语言的参考文档；检测所需语言服务器是否安装，缺了就安装，必要时写入配置（如 .codex/lsp-client.json），并用真实文件验证一次诊断往返、返回 OK/FAIL，让诊断、跳转定义等功能可用。
howto.when: 当项目需要安装或接通语言服务器，或出现“no LSP server configured”报错时触发；会先按文件扩展名判断语言，再执行后续安装与配置。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目的 Python 语言服务器装好并配置上。
say.note: 检测语言后安装服务器；仅在需要时写入配置。

say.text: 检测一下当前目录，看看哪些语言服务器装了、哪些还没装。
say.note: 运行检测脚本，返回各语言的安装与配置状态。

say.text: 跑一下 verify-lsp，检查 app.ts 的诊断能不能正常返回。
say.note: 会启动服务器请求一次诊断，返回 OK/FAIL。

howto.what_en: Claude detects language by file extension, reads the matching reference, installs/configures the language server (writing e.g. .codex/lsp-client.json), then runs a real diagnostics roundtrip and reports OK/FAIL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a project needs an LSP installed or wired up, or when a 'no LSP server configured' error appears. It first identifies the language by file extension, then installs and configures as needed.

say_en.text: Set up the Python language server for this project.
say_en.note: Detects the language, installs the server, and writes config only if needed.

say_en.text: Scan this folder and tell me which language servers are missing.
say_en.note: Runs the detection script and reports install/config status.

say_en.text: Verify diagnostics for app.ts with verify-lsp.
say_en.note: Starts the server, requests diagnostics, returns OK/FAIL.
